name: docx-creator
description: >- Produces Word (.docx) and exports existing Word/WPS manuscripts to PDF, preserving revisions, tables and images, especially Chinese formal documents via a verified OpenXML generator with mandatory visual verification. Use for 生成 Word 文档 / 写合同 docx / 把 markdown 转成 Word / 中文排版. Not for Markdown → PDF (use daymade-docs:pdf-creator).
author: daymade
